#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    int n;
    iss >> n;
    const int MOD = 1000000007;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> mat(n + 1, std::vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
    long long sum = 0;

    for (int row = 0; row <= n; row++) {
        mat[row][0] = 1;
        if ((row & 1) == 1) {
            sum = (sum + 1) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) {
        for (int col = 1; col <= row; col++) {
            mat[row][col] = (mat[row][col - 1] + mat[row - 1][col]) % MOD;
            if (((row + col) & 1) == 1) {
                sum = (sum + mat[row][col]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << sum << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
